name: @pipeworx/mcp-bamboohr

tools.name: bamboohr_list_employees
tools.description: List all employees with directory info. Returns IDs, names, departments, job titles, and contact details.

tools.name: bamboohr_get_employee
tools.description: Get detailed employee info by ID (e.g., "12345"). Specify fields like firstName, lastName, email, department. Returns requested data.

tools.name: bamboohr_get_directory
tools.description: Get complete employee directory with names, titles, departments, contact info, and manager assignments for all staff.

tools.name: bamboohr_list_timeoff
tools.description: Search time-off requests by date range (e.g., "2024-01-01" to "2024-12-31"). Returns approved/pending requests with employee names and absence types.

tools.name: bamboohr_get_employee_files
tools.description: Get files in an employee's profile by ID. Returns file names, upload dates, and file types.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bamboohr forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bamboohr pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
